Play the lecture in five steps

“Defend BlueFern” turns Class 10 — firewalls, remote access and Wi-Fi, web-application security, security software and the target architecture — into five missions. This guide shows every click with short animations recorded from the real game.

⏱ 5 minutes to learn💻 one HTML file, works offline🎓 formative — never graded

The loop of every mission

1 Predict→2 Learn→3 Lab→4 Cards→5 Boss→🏅 badge + next mission
✅ What you need: the file CS474_Class10_Game_Defend_BlueFern.html and a modern browser. Double-click the file to open it.
1

Start the game and finish Mission 0

  1. Open CS474_Class10_Game_Defend_BlueFern.html in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. No installation, no account, no Internet needed.
  2. Click Start Mission 0 — Briefing, read it, and click Briefing read.
  3. Read the legal rules, tick the box, and click Accept. Mission 1 unlocks.
  4. Your XP and rank appear in the top bar. Click 🗺 Map to see the missions.
💡 The legal step is not a formality: the simulators are course exercises, and nothing in this game is ever done against a real system.
2

Predict first, then learn

  1. On the map, click Mission 1.
  2. Predict: read the BlueFern problem and choose what you think happens. The explanation appears at once.
  3. Learn: click each grey bar to open a part of the lesson (+5 XP each).
  4. The slides of the lesson are on the right. Use ◀ ▶ or click a small slide; every new slide earns XP.
💡 Being wrong in the Predict stage is useful — it shows you exactly what the lesson is about to explain.
3

Run the lab, then flip the cards

  1. Lab: read the real-life example — the task and how it relates to the lesson are in the two boxes on top.
  2. Run the simulator with Start or Step; Restart begins again; Copy copies its code. ⛶ opens it full screen.
  3. Watch the animation, then click I ran it to the end (+25 XP).
  4. Cards: say the answer aloud, then click the card to turn it (+5 XP the first time).
💡 The simulators run entirely inside your browser: they send no packets and contact no website.
4

Beat the boss and earn the badge

  1. Boss: six questions — four MCQ (Multiple-Choice Question) with one answer and two MSQ (Multiple-Select Question) with several; the number expected is in round brackets.
  2. Use 💡 Hint if you are stuck, tick your answer, click Check.
  3. Green shows the correct options; every option has its own explanation — read the red ones.
  4. When all six are checked: a badge, +50 XP, and the next mission unlocks. One BlueFern weakness turns green on the map.
💡 The boss quiz is formative: it does not count toward your grade. Its only purpose is to show you what to review.
5

Use the rest of the game for review

  1. 🖼 Slides — all 56 slides, each with the lecture text it illustrates; the ← → keys move.
  2. 🧪 Bench — the five simulators, to run again, open full screen or download.
  3. 🛠 Lab — the three exercises of Binder Part 8 that follow the lecture, with an animation.
  4. 🛰 Intel — the videos, the official links and a searchable list of every abbreviation. ⚖ Legal — the rules.
💡 Check any link with VirusTotal or Google Safe Browsing before you open it (Legal Notice, Annex C).

Help — common questions

Is the game graded?

No. XP, ranks and badges are for you only, and nothing is sent anywhere. The game is formative self-study.

Where is my progress saved?

In this browser, on this computer. Another browser, a private window or another computer starts from zero.

The simulator stays blank.

Wait two seconds, or click ⛶ Open full screen. If your browser blocks pop-ups, allow them for this file.

Mission 2 is locked.

Finish the boss of Mission 1 (all six questions checked) — or tick “review mode” on the map.

A video does not open.

The videos are on YouTube and need the Internet; everything else works offline.

Can I use the game on my phone?

Yes, it adapts to small screens, but the simulators are easier to read on a laptop.
